name: Ambush
overview: The biblical concept of ambush is illustrated through several historical instances where strategic surprise was employed in warfare, such as Joshua's command to lay an ambush behind Ai (Joshua 8:2) and the coordinated night attacks by Abimelech on Shechem (Judges 9:25, 34). Israel also used ambush tactics around Gibeah to confront their enemies (Judges 20:29). Beyond literal warfare, Jeremiah 51:12 portrays ambushes figuratively as part of God's sovereign judgment against Babylon, showing that ambushes can represent divine strategy in executing His purposes.
